data_quality.notes: Gold refresh: Spring Airlines baggage is fare-package, route-distance, purchase-channel, membership-level, and timing driven, with online baggage usually cheaper than airport counter pricing after the Aug. 16, 2026 pricing update.

fees.timing: at booking / manage booking / at airport

fees.amount: Handled as checked baggage; excess charges apply

policy_change_history.summary: Spring Airlines introduced a baggage pricing structure based on route type, distance, purchase scenario, and weight tiers, with online purchase generally cheaper than airport counter purchase.
